issues.description: image.tobytes() on PIL Image without mode conversion produces wrong bytes when source isn't RGB
issues.detail: Gemini returns PNG/JPEG which PIL may open as RGBA, P, or L. Calling image.tobytes() then declaring format='RGB' yields a buffer whose byte count and channel order do not match the declared format. Termination/invariant: the invariant 'len(bytes) == width*height*3' fails for RGBA inputs. Convert via image.convert('RGB') before tobytes(). ASYMPTOTICALLY-OK-PRACTICALLY-WRONG.

issues.description: Module-level mutation of genai._api_client.READ_BUFFER_SIZE is a global side effect at import time
issues.detail: Reaching into a private underscore attribute and mutating it during module import affects every consumer of google-genai in the process, not just GoogleLLMService. The comment honestly labels it 'temporary hack' but offers no invariant for when it can be removed or how it interacts with concurrent users. NEEDS-LITERATE-COMMENT with an issue link and a guard against double-application.

issues.description: Image-model detection by substring 'image' in model name is fragile
issues.detail: The predicate `'image' in self._model_name` will misfire on any future model whose name contains the substring (e.g. 'imagen', 'image-edit', 'vision-image-preview') and silently disable thinking budget. Prefer an explicit allowlist or a capability flag. State the invariant the branch is meant to preserve. UNDER-AUDITED.

issues.description: Each inline_data part decodes and re-encodes the full image synchronously inside the streaming loop
issues.detail: Pillow's Image.open is lazy but tobytes() forces a full decode on the event loop thread. For a 1024x1024 image this is multi-millisecond CPU work per chunk; multiple parts compound. No measurement is shown. Either offload to a thread (asyncio.to_thread) or pass raw bytes through if the consumer accepts encoded formats. ASYMPTOTICALLY-OK-PRACTICALLY-SLOW.

issues.description: Default model change from gemini-2.0-flash to gemini-2.5-flash is a silent behavior shift
issues.detail: Existing callers relying on the default will see different latency, cost, and token-usage characteristics. The CHANGELOG notes it, but a deprecation/warning path would be kinder. Not a correctness issue; flagging for literate-comment discipline so downstream readers know the invariant changed.

issues.description: No test or proof accompanies the new image-emission branch
issues.detail: Per the motto: proofs catch what tests miss, tests catch what proofs miss. The new elif branch has neither. A small unit test that feeds a synthetic inline_data part and asserts an OutputImageRawFrame with correct size/mode would catch the RGB/RGBA bug above. UNDER-AUDITED.

review.summary: The feature is small and the diff is mostly mechanical, but the one substantive new branch — converting Gemini inline_data parts into OutputImageRawFrame — is under-audited. The PIL-to-raw-bytes conversion silently assumes RGB and will produce malformed buffers for the RGBA/P modes Gemini can return; this is the kind of bug a stated invariant ('decoded buffer length equals width*height*3') would have caught immediately. Secondary concerns: a module-import-time monkeypatch of a private google-genai attribute, substring-based model-class detection, and a synchronous decode on the event loop without measurement. The default-model bump is fine but worth flagging as a behavior change. Recommend: add image.convert('RGB'), narrow the image-model predicate, document the READ_BUFFER_SIZE hack with an exit condition, and add one unit test for the new branch.
